command:
set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d ''); echo call_state=$STATE; test "$STATE" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E '^shell[[:space:]]+[0-9]+[[:space:]]+shizuku_server$'; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge/.MainActivity --ez run_shizuku_endurance_probe true >/dev/null; sleep 3; LOG=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief -s AiCallBridge:I '*:S'); printf '%s
' "$LOG"; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'shizuku_endurance_probe_start=true'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -q 'probe=shizuku-user-service-endurance-v1'; printf '%s
' "$LOG" | grep -Eiq 'error=.*(cellular call.*not active|AudioManager.*IN_CALL|not active.*IN_CALL)'; echo phase2d_endurance_probe_offcall_guard_ok=true
